nodes.text:
Human metapneumovirus (hMPV) is a respiratory virus causing cold-like symptoms, including cough, fever, and nasal congestion. It spreads through respiratory droplets and contact with contaminated surfaces. Most individuals recover without specific treatment. 
#HMPV #HMPVinIndia
